subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should scoped Back navigation be enabled by default for every custom and external channel setup adapter, or only for adapters that explicitly declare replay-safe behavior?
rationale: Existing plugin versions can perform durable effects without invoking the newly relied-upon callback, and repository history cannot establish that replaying every third-party adapter is an accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Require explicit replay-safe capability
options.body: Default custom and external adapters to legacy non-replay behavior, then opt adapters in after they declare and test their persistence boundary.

options.title: Restrict Back to bundled safe flows
options.body: Enable scoped Back only for bundled or declarative setup paths reviewed in this PR while leaving arbitrary custom adapters unchanged.

options.title: Accept default-on replay
options.body: Enable Back for every adapter and explicitly accept that older plugins may repeat unreported durable effects during navigation.

recommendation.title: Require explicit replay-safe capability
recommendation.body: Default custom and external adapters to legacy non-replay behavior, then opt adapters in after they declare and test their persistence boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are actively developing both this navigation change and the overlapping shared channel-setup contract.
